379::mlir::ParseResult AssumeDetOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
380 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand hintRawOperand{};
381 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> hintOperands(&hintRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc hintOperandsLoc;
382 (void)hintOperandsLoc;
383 ::mlir::Type hintRawType{};
384 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::Type> hintTypes(&hintRawType, 1);
385
386 hintOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
387 if (parser.parseOperand(hintRawOperand))
388 return ::mlir::failure();
389 {
390 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
391 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
392 return ::mlir::failure();
393 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
394 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
395 })))
396 return ::mlir::failure();
397 }
398 if (parser.parseColon())
399 return ::mlir::failure();
400
401 {
402 ::mlir::Type type;
403 if (parser.parseCustomTypeWithFallback(type))
404 return ::mlir::failure();
405 hintRawType = type;
406 }
407 if (parser.resolveOperands(hintOperands, hintTypes, hintOperandsLoc, result.operands))
408 return ::mlir::failure();
409 return ::mlir::success();
410}

412void AssumeDetOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
413 _odsPrinter << ' ';
414 _odsPrinter << getHint();
415 ::llvm::SmallVector<::llvm::StringRef, 2> elidedAttrs;
416 _odsPrinter.printOptionalAttrDict((*this)->getAttrs(), elidedAttrs);
417 _odsPrinter << ' ' << ":";
418 _odsPrinter << ' ';
419 {
420 auto type = getHint().getType();
421 if (auto validType = ::llvm::dyn_cast<::mlir::Type>(type))
422 _odsPrinter.printStrippedAttrOrType(validType);
423 else
424 _odsPrinter << type;
425 }
426}

580 return ::mlir::failure();
581 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
582 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";

584 return ::mlir::failure();
585 }
586 return ::mlir::success();

641::llvm::LogicalResult ContractOpAdaptor::verify(::mlir::Location loc) {
642 auto tblgen_arg_attrs = getProperties().arg_attrs; (void)tblgen_arg_attrs;
643 auto tblgen_function_type = getProperties().function_type; (void)tblgen_function_type;
644 if (!tblgen_function_type) return emitError(loc, "'verif.contract' op requires attribute 'function_type'");
645 auto tblgen_res_attrs = getProperties().res_attrs; (void)tblgen_res_attrs;
646 auto tblgen_sym_name = getProperties().sym_name; (void)tblgen_sym_name;
647 if (!tblgen_sym_name) return emitError(loc, "'verif.contract' op requires attribute 'sym_name'");
648 auto tblgen_target = getProperties().target; (void)tblgen_target;
649 if (!tblgen_target) return emitError(loc, "'verif.contract' op requires attribute 'target'");
650
651 if (tblgen_sym_name && !((::llvm::isa<::mlir::StringAttr>(tblgen_sym_name))))
652 return emitError(loc, "'verif.contract' op attribute 'sym_name' failed to satisfy constraint: string attribute");
653
654 if (tblgen_target && !((::llvm::isa<::mlir::SymbolRefAttr>(tblgen_target))))
655 return emitError(loc, "'verif.contract' op attribute 'target' failed to satisfy constraint: symbol reference attribute");
656
657 if (tblgen_function_type && !(((::llvm::isa<::mlir::TypeAttr>(tblgen_function_type))) && ((::llvm::isa<::mlir::FunctionType>(::llvm::cast<::mlir::TypeAttr>(tblgen_function_type).getValue()))) && ((::llvm::isa<::mlir::FunctionType>(::llvm::cast<::mlir::TypeAttr>(tblgen_function_type).getValue())))))
658 return emitError(loc, "'verif.contract' op attribute 'function_type' failed to satisfy constraint: type attribute of function type");
659
660 if (tblgen_arg_attrs && !(((::llvm::isa<::mlir::ArrayAttr>(tblgen_arg_attrs))) && (::llvm::all_of(::llvm::cast<::mlir::ArrayAttr>(tblgen_arg_attrs), [&](::mlir::Attribute attr) { return attr && ((::llvm::isa<::mlir::DictionaryAttr>(attr))); }))))
661 return emitError(loc, "'verif.contract' op attribute 'arg_attrs' failed to satisfy constraint: Array of dictionary attributes");
662
663 if (tblgen_res_attrs && !(((::llvm::isa<::mlir::ArrayAttr>(tblgen_res_attrs))) && (::llvm::all_of(::llvm::cast<::mlir::ArrayAttr>(tblgen_res_attrs), [&](::mlir::Attribute attr) { return attr && ((::llvm::isa<::mlir::DictionaryAttr>(attr))); }))))
664 return emitError(loc, "'verif.contract' op attribute 'res_attrs' failed to satisfy constraint: Array of dictionary attributes");
665 return ::mlir::success();
666}

668::llvm::LogicalResult ContractOp::setPropertiesFromAttr(Properties &prop, ::mlir::Attribute attr, ::llvm::function_ref<::mlir::InFlightDiagnostic()> emitError) {
669 ::mlir::DictionaryAttr dict = ::llvm::dyn_cast<::mlir::DictionaryAttr>(attr);
670 if (!dict) {
671 emitError() << "expected DictionaryAttr to set properties";
672 return ::mlir::failure();
673 }
674
675 {
676 auto &propStorage = prop.arg_attrs;
677 auto attr = dict.get("arg_attrs");
678 if (attr) {
679 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
680 if (convertedAttr) {
681 propStorage = convertedAttr;
682 } else {
683 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `arg_attrs` in property conversion: " << attr;
684 return ::mlir::failure();
685 }
686 }
687 }
688
689 {
690 auto &propStorage = prop.function_type;
691 auto attr = dict.get("function_type");
692 if (attr) {
693 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
694 if (convertedAttr) {
695 propStorage = convertedAttr;
696 } else {
697 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `function_type` in property conversion: " << attr;
698 return ::mlir::failure();
699 }
700 }
701 }
702
703 {
704 auto &propStorage = prop.res_attrs;
705 auto attr = dict.get("res_attrs");
706 if (attr) {
707 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
708 if (convertedAttr) {
709 propStorage = convertedAttr;
710 } else {
711 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `res_attrs` in property conversion: " << attr;
712 return ::mlir::failure();
713 }
714 }
715 }
716
717 {
718 auto &propStorage = prop.sym_name;
719 auto attr = dict.get("sym_name");
720 if (attr) {
721 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
722 if (convertedAttr) {
723 propStorage = convertedAttr;
724 } else {
725 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `sym_name` in property conversion: " << attr;
726 return ::mlir::failure();
727 }
728 }
729 }
730
731 {
732 auto &propStorage = prop.target;
733 auto attr = dict.get("target");
734 if (attr) {
735 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
736 if (convertedAttr) {
737 propStorage = convertedAttr;
738 } else {
739 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `target` in property conversion: " << attr;
740 return ::mlir::failure();
741 }
742 }
743 }
744 return ::mlir::success();
745}

747::mlir::Attribute ContractOp::getPropertiesAsAttr(::mlir::MLIRContext *ctx, const Properties &prop) {
748 ::mlir::SmallVector<::mlir::NamedAttribute> attrs;
749 ::mlir::Builder odsBuilder{ctx};
750
751 {
752 const auto &propStorage = prop.arg_attrs;
753 if (propStorage)
754 attrs.push_back(odsBuilder.getNamedAttr("arg_attrs",
755 propStorage));
756 }
757
758 {
759 const auto &propStorage = prop.function_type;
760 if (propStorage)
761 attrs.push_back(odsBuilder.getNamedAttr("function_type",
762 propStorage));
763 }
764
765 {
766 const auto &propStorage = prop.res_attrs;
767 if (propStorage)
768 attrs.push_back(odsBuilder.getNamedAttr("res_attrs",
769 propStorage));
770 }
771
772 {
773 const auto &propStorage = prop.sym_name;
774 if (propStorage)
775 attrs.push_back(odsBuilder.getNamedAttr("sym_name",
776 propStorage));
777 }
778
779 {
780 const auto &propStorage = prop.target;
781 if (propStorage)
782 attrs.push_back(odsBuilder.getNamedAttr("target",
783 propStorage));
784 }
785
786 if (!attrs.empty())
787 return odsBuilder.getDictionaryAttr(attrs);
788 return {};

858::llvm::LogicalResult ContractOp::verifyInherentAttrs(::mlir::OperationName opName, ::mlir::NamedAttrList &attrs, llvm::function_ref<::mlir::InFlightDiagnostic()> emitError) {
859 {
860 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getArgAttrsAttrName(opName));
861 if (attr && ::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops4(attr, "arg_attrs", emitError)))
862 return ::mlir::failure();
863 }
864
865 {
866 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getFunctionTypeAttrName(opName));
867 if (attr && ::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops3(attr, "function_type", emitError)))
868 return ::mlir::failure();
869 }
870
871 {
872 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getResAttrsAttrName(opName));
873 if (attr && ::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops4(attr, "res_attrs", emitError)))
874 return ::mlir::failure();
875 }
876
877 {
878 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getSymNameAttrName(opName));
879 if (attr && ::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops1(attr, "sym_name", emitError)))
880 return ::mlir::failure();
881 }
882
883 {
884 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getTargetAttrName(opName));
885 if (attr && ::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops2(attr, "target", emitError)))
886 return ::mlir::failure();
887 }
888 return ::mlir::success();
889}

1072::llvm::LogicalResult ContractOp::verifyInvariantsImpl() {
1073 auto tblgen_arg_attrs = getProperties().arg_attrs; (void)tblgen_arg_attrs;
1074 auto tblgen_function_type = getProperties().function_type; (void)tblgen_function_type;
1075 if (!tblgen_function_type) return emitOpError("requires attribute 'function_type'");
1076 auto tblgen_res_attrs = getProperties().res_attrs; (void)tblgen_res_attrs;
1077 auto tblgen_sym_name = getProperties().sym_name; (void)tblgen_sym_name;
1078 if (!tblgen_sym_name) return emitOpError("requires attribute 'sym_name'");
1079 auto tblgen_target = getProperties().target; (void)tblgen_target;
1080 if (!tblgen_target) return emitOpError("requires attribute 'target'");
1081
1082 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops1(*this, tblgen_sym_name, "sym_name")))
1083 return ::mlir::failure();
1084
1085 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops2(*this, tblgen_target, "target")))
1086 return ::mlir::failure();
1087
1088 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops3(*this, tblgen_function_type, "function_type")))
1089 return ::mlir::failure();
1090
1091 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops4(*this, tblgen_arg_attrs, "arg_attrs")))
1092 return ::mlir::failure();
1093
1094 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops4(*this, tblgen_res_attrs, "res_attrs")))
1095 return ::mlir::failure();
1096 {
1097 unsigned index = 0; (void)index;
1098
1099 for (auto &region : ::llvm::MutableArrayRef((*this)->getRegion(0)))
1100 if (::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_region_constraint_Ops1(*this, region, "body", index++)))
1101 return ::mlir::failure();
1102 }
1103 return ::mlir::success();
1104}
1105
1106::llvm::LogicalResult ContractOp::verifyInvariants() {
1107 if(::mlir::succeeded(verifyInvariantsImpl()) && ::mlir::succeeded(verify()))
1108 return ::mlir::success();
1109 return ::mlir::failure();
1110}

1112::llvm::LogicalResult ContractOp::setPropertiesFromParsedAttr(Properties &prop, ::mlir::Attribute attr, ::llvm::function_ref<::mlir::InFlightDiagnostic()> emitError) {
1113 ::mlir::DictionaryAttr dict = ::llvm::dyn_cast<::mlir::DictionaryAttr>(attr);
1114 if (!dict) {
1115 emitError() << "expected DictionaryAttr to set properties";
1116 return ::mlir::failure();
1117 }
1118 // keep track of used keys in the input dictionary to be able to error out
1119 // if there are some unknown ones.
1120 ::mlir::DenseSet<::mlir::StringAttr> usedKeys;
1121 ::mlir::MLIRContext *ctx = dict.getContext();
1122 (void)ctx;
1123 {
1124
1125 auto &propStorage = prop.sym_name;
1126 auto sym_nameAttrName = ::mlir::StringAttr::get(ctx, "sym_name");
1127 auto attr = dict.get(sym_nameAttrName);
1128 usedKeys.insert(sym_nameAttrName);
1129 if (attr || /*isRequired=*/true) {
1130 if (!attr) {
1131 emitError() << "expected key entry for sym_name in DictionaryAttr to set "
1132 "Properties.";
1133 return ::mlir::failure();
1134 }
1135 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
1136 if (convertedAttr) {
1137 propStorage = convertedAttr;
1138 } else {
1139 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `sym_name` in property conversion: " << attr;
1140 return ::mlir::failure();
1141 }
1142 }
1143 }
1144 {
1145
1146 auto &propStorage = prop.target;
1147 auto targetAttrName = ::mlir::StringAttr::get(ctx, "target");
1148 auto attr = dict.get(targetAttrName);
1149 usedKeys.insert(targetAttrName);
1150 if (attr || /*isRequired=*/true) {
1151 if (!attr) {
1152 emitError() << "expected key entry for target in DictionaryAttr to set "
1153 "Properties.";
1154 return ::mlir::failure();
1155 }
1156 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
1157 if (convertedAttr) {
1158 propStorage = convertedAttr;
1159 } else {
1160 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `target` in property conversion: " << attr;
1161 return ::mlir::failure();
1162 }
1163 }
1164 }
1165 {
1166
1167 auto &propStorage = prop.function_type;
1168 auto function_typeAttrName = ::mlir::StringAttr::get(ctx, "function_type");
1169 auto attr = dict.get(function_typeAttrName);
1170 usedKeys.insert(function_typeAttrName);
1171 if (attr || /*isRequired=*/true) {
1172 if (!attr) {
1173 emitError() << "expected key entry for function_type in DictionaryAttr to set "
1174 "Properties.";
1175 return ::mlir::failure();
1176 }
1177 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
1178 if (convertedAttr) {
1179 propStorage = convertedAttr;
1180 } else {
1181 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `function_type` in property conversion: " << attr;
1182 return ::mlir::failure();
1183 }
1184 }
1185 }
1186 {
1187
1188 auto &propStorage = prop.arg_attrs;
1189 auto arg_attrsAttrName = ::mlir::StringAttr::get(ctx, "arg_attrs");
1190 auto attr = dict.get(arg_attrsAttrName);
1191 usedKeys.insert(arg_attrsAttrName);
1192 if (attr || /*isRequired=*/false) {
1193 if (!attr) {
1194 emitError() << "expected key entry for arg_attrs in DictionaryAttr to set "
1195 "Properties.";
1196 return ::mlir::failure();
1197 }
1198 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
1199 if (convertedAttr) {
1200 propStorage = convertedAttr;
1201 } else {
1202 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `arg_attrs` in property conversion: " << attr;
1203 return ::mlir::failure();
1204 }
1205 }
1206 }
1207 {
1208
1209 auto &propStorage = prop.res_attrs;
1210 auto res_attrsAttrName = ::mlir::StringAttr::get(ctx, "res_attrs");
1211 auto attr = dict.get(res_attrsAttrName);
1212 usedKeys.insert(res_attrsAttrName);
1213 if (attr || /*isRequired=*/false) {
1214 if (!attr) {
1215 emitError() << "expected key entry for res_attrs in DictionaryAttr to set "
1216 "Properties.";
1217 return ::mlir::failure();
1218 }
1219 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
1220 if (convertedAttr) {
1221 propStorage = convertedAttr;
1222 } else {
1223 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `res_attrs` in property conversion: " << attr;
1224 return ::mlir::failure();
1225 }
1226 }
1227 }
1228
1229 for (::mlir::NamedAttribute attr : dict) {
1230 if (!usedKeys.contains(attr.getName()))
1231 return emitError() << "unknown key '" << attr.getName() <<
1232 "' when parsing properties dictionary";
1233 }
1234 return ::mlir::success();
1235}

1390::mlir::ParseResult DecreasesOp::parse(::mlir::OpAsmParser &parser, ::mlir::OperationState &result) {
1391 ::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand valueRawOperand{};
1392 ::llvm::ArrayRef<::mlir::OpAsmParser::UnresolvedOperand> valueOperands(&valueRawOperand, 1); ::llvm::SMLoc valueOperandsLoc;
1393 (void)valueOperandsLoc;
1394
1395 valueOperandsLoc = parser.getCurrentLocation();
1396 if (parser.parseOperand(valueRawOperand))
1397 return ::mlir::failure();
1398 {
1399 auto loc = parser.getCurrentLocation();(void)loc;
1400 if (parser.parseOptionalAttrDict(result.attributes))
1401 return ::mlir::failure();
1402 if (failed(verifyInherentAttrs(result.name, result.attributes, [&]() {
1403 return parser.emitError(loc) << "'" << result.name.getStringRef() << "' op ";
1404 })))
1405 return ::mlir::failure();
1406 }
1407 ::mlir::Type odsBuildableType0 = ::llzk::felt::FeltType::get(parser.getBuilder().getContext());
1408 if (parser.resolveOperands(valueOperands, odsBuildableType0, valueOperandsLoc, result.operands))
1409 return ::mlir::failure();
1410 return ::mlir::success();
1411}

2084llvm::hash_code IncludeOp::computePropertiesHash(const Properties &prop) {

2177::llvm::LogicalResult IncludeOp::verifyInherentAttrs(::mlir::OperationName opName, ::mlir::NamedAttrList &attrs, llvm::function_ref<::mlir::InFlightDiagnostic()> emitError) {
2178 {
2179 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getArgAttrsAttrName(opName));

2184 {
2185 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getCalleeAttrName(opName));
2186 if (attr && ::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops2(attr, "callee", emitError)))
2187 return ::mlir::failure();
2188 }
2189
2190 {
2191 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getMapOpGroupSizesAttrName(opName));
2192 if (attr && ::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops6(attr, "mapOpGroupSizes", emitError)))
2193 return ::mlir::failure();
2194 }
2195
2196 {
2197 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getNumDimsPerMapAttrName(opName));
2198 if (attr && ::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops6(attr, "numDimsPerMap", emitError)))
2199 return ::mlir::failure();
2200 }
2201
2202 {
2203 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getResAttrsAttrName(opName));
2204 if (attr && ::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops4(attr, "res_attrs", emitError)))
2205 return ::mlir::failure();
2206 }
2207
2208 {
2209 ::mlir::Attribute attr = attrs.get(getTemplateParamsAttrName(opName));
2210 if (attr && ::mlir::failed(__mlir_ods_local_attr_constraint_Ops5(attr, "templateParams", emitError)))
2211 return ::mlir::failure();

2213 return ::mlir::success();

2216::llvm::LogicalResult IncludeOp::readProperties(::mlir::DialectBytecodeReader &reader, ::mlir::OperationState &state) {
2217 auto &prop = state.getOrAddProperties<Properties>(); (void)prop;
2218 if (::mlir::failed(reader.readOptionalAttribute(prop.arg_attrs)))
2219 return ::mlir::failure();
2220
2221 if (::mlir::failed(reader.readAttribute(prop.callee)))
2222 return ::mlir::failure();
2223
2224 if (::mlir::failed(reader.readAttribute(prop.mapOpGroupSizes)))
2225 return ::mlir::failure();
2226
2227 if (::mlir::failed(reader.readOptionalAttribute(prop.numDimsPerMap)))
2228 return ::mlir::failure();
2229
2230 if (reader.getBytecodeVersion() < /*kNativePropertiesODSSegmentSize=*/6) {
2231 auto &propStorage = prop.operandSegmentSizes;
2232 ::mlir::DenseI32ArrayAttr attr;
2233 if (::mlir::failed(reader.readAttribute(attr))) return ::mlir::failure();
2234 if (attr.size() > static_cast<int64_t>(sizeof(propStorage) / sizeof(int32_t))) {
2235 reader.emitError("size mismatch for operand/result_segment_size");
2236 return ::mlir::failure();
2237 }
2238 ::llvm::copy(::llvm::ArrayRef<int32_t>(attr), propStorage.begin());
2239 }
2240
2241 if (::mlir::failed(reader.readOptionalAttribute(prop.res_attrs)))
2242 return ::mlir::failure();
2243
2244 if (::mlir::failed(reader.readOptionalAttribute(prop.templateParams)))
2245 return ::mlir::failure();
2246
2247 {
2248 auto &propStorage = prop.operandSegmentSizes;
2249 auto readProp = [&]() {
2250
2251 if (reader.getBytecodeVersion() >= /*kNativePropertiesODSSegmentSize=*/6)
2252 return reader.readSparseArray(::llvm::MutableArrayRef(propStorage));
2253;
2254 return ::mlir::success();
2255 };
2256 if (::mlir::failed(readProp()))
2257 return ::mlir::failure();
2258 }
2259 return ::mlir::success();
2260}

2262void IncludeOp::writeProperties(::mlir::DialectBytecodeWriter &writer) {
2263 auto &prop = getProperties(); (void)prop;
2264
2265 writer.writeOptionalAttribute(prop.arg_attrs);
2266 writer.writeAttribute(prop.callee);
2267 writer.writeAttribute(prop.mapOpGroupSizes);
2268
2269 writer.writeOptionalAttribute(prop.numDimsPerMap);
2270
2271if (writer.getBytecodeVersion() < /*kNativePropertiesODSSegmentSize=*/6) {
2272 auto &propStorage = prop.operandSegmentSizes;
2273 writer.writeAttribute(::mlir::DenseI32ArrayAttr::get(this->getContext(), propStorage));
2274}
2275
2276 writer.writeOptionalAttribute(prop.res_attrs);
2277
2278 writer.writeOptionalAttribute(prop.templateParams);
2279
2280 {
2281 auto &propStorage = prop.operandSegmentSizes;
2282
2283 if (writer.getBytecodeVersion() >= /*kNativePropertiesODSSegmentSize=*/6)
2284 writer.writeSparseArray(::llvm::ArrayRef(propStorage));
2285;
2286 }

2559::llvm::LogicalResult IncludeOp::setPropertiesFromParsedAttr(Properties &prop, ::mlir::Attribute attr, ::llvm::function_ref<::mlir::InFlightDiagnostic()> emitError) {
2560 ::mlir::DictionaryAttr dict = ::llvm::dyn_cast<::mlir::DictionaryAttr>(attr);
2561 if (!dict) {
2562 emitError() << "expected DictionaryAttr to set properties";
2563 return ::mlir::failure();
2564 }
2565 // keep track of used keys in the input dictionary to be able to error out
2566 // if there are some unknown ones.
2567 ::mlir::DenseSet<::mlir::StringAttr> usedKeys;
2568 ::mlir::MLIRContext *ctx = dict.getContext();
2569 (void)ctx;
2570 {
2571
2572 auto &propStorage = prop.mapOpGroupSizes;
2573 auto mapOpGroupSizesAttrName = ::mlir::StringAttr::get(ctx, "mapOpGroupSizes");
2574 auto attr = dict.get(mapOpGroupSizesAttrName);
2575 usedKeys.insert(mapOpGroupSizesAttrName);
2576 if (attr || /*isRequired=*/true) {
2577 if (!attr) {
2578 emitError() << "expected key entry for mapOpGroupSizes in DictionaryAttr to set "
2579 "Properties.";
2580 return ::mlir::failure();
2581 }
2582 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
2583 if (convertedAttr) {
2584 propStorage = convertedAttr;
2585 } else {
2586 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `mapOpGroupSizes` in property conversion: " << attr;
2587 return ::mlir::failure();
2588 }
2589 }
2590 }
2591 {
2592
2593 auto &propStorage = prop.arg_attrs;
2594 auto arg_attrsAttrName = ::mlir::StringAttr::get(ctx, "arg_attrs");
2595 auto attr = dict.get(arg_attrsAttrName);
2596 usedKeys.insert(arg_attrsAttrName);
2597 if (attr || /*isRequired=*/false) {
2598 if (!attr) {
2599 emitError() << "expected key entry for arg_attrs in DictionaryAttr to set "
2600 "Properties.";
2601 return ::mlir::failure();
2602 }
2603 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
2604 if (convertedAttr) {
2605 propStorage = convertedAttr;
2606 } else {
2607 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `arg_attrs` in property conversion: " << attr;
2608 return ::mlir::failure();
2609 }
2610 }
2611 }
2612 {
2613
2614 auto &propStorage = prop.res_attrs;
2615 auto res_attrsAttrName = ::mlir::StringAttr::get(ctx, "res_attrs");
2616 auto attr = dict.get(res_attrsAttrName);
2617 usedKeys.insert(res_attrsAttrName);
2618 if (attr || /*isRequired=*/false) {
2619 if (!attr) {
2620 emitError() << "expected key entry for res_attrs in DictionaryAttr to set "
2621 "Properties.";
2622 return ::mlir::failure();
2623 }
2624 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
2625 if (convertedAttr) {
2626 propStorage = convertedAttr;
2627 } else {
2628 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `res_attrs` in property conversion: " << attr;
2629 return ::mlir::failure();
2630 }
2631 }
2632 }
2633
2634 for (::mlir::NamedAttribute attr : dict) {
2635 if (!usedKeys.contains(attr.getName()))
2636 return emitError() << "unknown key '" << attr.getName() <<
2637 "' when parsing properties dictionary";
2638 }
2639 return ::mlir::success();
2640}

2642void IncludeOp::print(::mlir::OpAsmPrinter &_odsPrinter) {
2643 _odsPrinter << ' ';
2644 _odsPrinter.printAttributeWithoutType(getCalleeAttr());
2645 if (((getTemplateParamsAttr()))) {
2646 _odsPrinter << "<";
2647 printTemplateParams(_odsPrinter, *this, getTemplateParamsAttr());
2648 _odsPrinter << ">";
2649 }
2650 _odsPrinter << "(";
2651 _odsPrinter << getArgOperands();
2652 _odsPrinter << ")";
2653 if (((!getMapOperands().empty()) || (getNumDimsPerMapAttr() != ::mlir::OpBuilder((*this)->getContext()).getDenseI32ArrayAttr({})))) {
2654 _odsPrinter << ' ' << "{";
2655 printMultiDimAndSymbolList(_odsPrinter, *this, getMapOperands(), getNumDimsPerMapAttr());
2656 _odsPrinter << "}";
2657 }
2658 _odsPrinter << ' ' << ":";
2659 _odsPrinter << ' ';
2660 _odsPrinter.printFunctionalType(getArgOperands().getTypes(), getOperation()->getResultTypes());
2661 _odsPrinter << ' ';
2662 printAttrDictWithWarnings(_odsPrinter, *this, getOperation()->getAttrDictionary(), getProperties());
2663}

3076::llvm::LogicalResult InvariantOp::setPropertiesFromParsedAttr(Properties &prop, ::mlir::Attribute attr, ::llvm::function_ref<::mlir::InFlightDiagnostic()> emitError) {
3077 ::mlir::DictionaryAttr dict = ::llvm::dyn_cast<::mlir::DictionaryAttr>(attr);

3087 {
3088
3089 auto &propStorage = prop.loop_name;
3090 auto loop_nameAttrName = ::mlir::StringAttr::get(ctx, "loop_name");
3091 auto attr = dict.get(loop_nameAttrName);
3092 usedKeys.insert(loop_nameAttrName);
3093 if (attr || /*isRequired=*/true) {
3094 if (!attr) {
3095 emitError() << "expected key entry for loop_name in DictionaryAttr to set "
3096 "Properties.";
3097 return ::mlir::failure();
3098 }
3099 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
3100 if (convertedAttr) {
3101 propStorage = convertedAttr;
3102 } else {
3103 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `loop_name` in property conversion: " << attr;
3104 return ::mlir::failure();
3105 }
3106 }
3107 }
3108 {
3109
3110 auto &propStorage = prop.loop_arg_types;
3111 auto loop_arg_typesAttrName = ::mlir::StringAttr::get(ctx, "loop_arg_types");
3112 auto attr = dict.get(loop_arg_typesAttrName);
3113 usedKeys.insert(loop_arg_typesAttrName);
3114 if (attr || /*isRequired=*/true) {
3115 if (!attr) {
3116 emitError() << "expected key entry for loop_arg_types in DictionaryAttr to set "
3117 "Properties.";
3118 return ::mlir::failure();
3119 }
3120 auto convertedAttr = ::llvm::dyn_cast<std::remove_reference_t<decltype(propStorage)>>(attr);
3121 if (convertedAttr) {
3122 propStorage = convertedAttr;
3123 } else {
3124 emitError() << "Invalid attribute `loop_arg_types` in property conversion: " << attr;
3125 return ::mlir::failure();
3126 }
3127 }
3128 }
3129
3130 for (::mlir::NamedAttribute attr : dict) {
3131 if (!usedKeys.contains(attr.getName()))
